variables.name: bronze_workspace_id
variables.note: Workspace holding the bronze layer. In this accelerator all layers share one workspace; split per value set if that changes.

variables.name: bronze_lakehouse_id
variables.note: Bronze lakehouse item id. Source value; resolve per environment before promotion.

variables.name: silver_lakehouse_id
variables.note: Silver lakehouse item id. Source value; resolve per environment before promotion.

variables.name: gold_warehouse_id
variables.note: Gold warehouse item id. Source value; resolve per environment before promotion.

variables.name: gold_sql_endpoint
variables.note: Gold warehouse SQL analytics endpoint host. Environment specific; regenerate per workspace.

variables.name: l1_notebook_id
variables.note: L1Transform-Generic-Fabric notebook item id used as the compute reference.

variables.name: capacity_id
variables.note: Capacity the workspace is assigned to. Declared for visibility; no documented Variable Library consumer slot exists for a pipeline capacityId.

variables.name: control_db_connection_id
variables.note: Connection to the controlDB SQL database. Declared for central visibility; pipeline activity connection binding is not a Variable Library consumer slot.

variables.name: source_sql_connection_id
variables.note: Connection to the WideWorldImporters source SQL database. Declared, not VL-wired.

variables.name: mirror_source_connection_id
variables.note: MirroredDatabase source connection (AzureSqlDatabase). Declared, not VL-wired.

variables.name: mirror_ingest_connection_id
variables.note: Connection used by Ingest MirrorDB Table. Declared, not VL-wired.
